scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec codegen && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/church-erp build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/church-erp typecheck && pnpm --filter ./scripts typecheck
scripts.typecheck:all: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.setup: cp -n .env.example .env 2>/dev/null; docker compose up -d && sleep 2 && pnpm install && pnpm run db:push
